title: Lunchline
description: Alabaster cream and charcoal ink with one deep evergreen panel, two warm sands and citron-olive hairlines. A light-weight neo-grotesk at large sizes, bold only for tiny tracked labels, plus a marker handwriting face for notes and names. Square and flat.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a warm-charcoal sibling with the evergreen a step lighter
primary is the evergreen of the formula panel and role labels; muted is the beige of the form band, secondary the lighter sand
border is the citron olive of every hairline
sets an extra --typeface-hand (Reenie Beanie) that the lunchline blocks read with a fallback to the display face
the gutter is 16px on phones and 56px from 1024px
name: lunchline-theme
